company_notes: Summary: Mid-market product-analytics SaaS building an in-app assistant + search layer. Ran 30-day Hosted API trial, now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and cost.
Trial metrics (hosted): avg QPS (baseline): 12, peak sustained QPS: 85 during weekday launches, short burst to 210 for config imports.
Observed concurrency: 60 concurrent generator sessions on weekday peak; P95 request concurrency spikes to ~180 during product release events.
Token mix (observed): ~62% short prompts+responses (<128 tokens), ~32% medium (128-1024 tokens), ~6% long-form (1024+ tokens). Average tokens per request: ~380.
Performance targets: P95 latency <= 300ms for conversational path, P95 <= 600ms for long summarization jobs; availability SLA expectation 99.9%.
Throughput goal for Dedicated: steady-state 120 QPS with 3x headroom for burst (target burst up to 360 QPS). Concurrent KV/cache sessions expected 350+ after rollout.
Cost sensitivity: targeting < $0.03/token-equivalent for production mix after batching/quantization/caching. Open to quantized model variants if quality delta < 5%.
Model preferences & routing: prefer Redwood-verified open models, fallback to smaller quantized variant for non-critical paths. Want model pinning per route and automatic fallback rules.
Security asks: SSO via SAML + SCIM, customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest, audit log export to Splunk, data residency control for EU customers.
POC details: 2-week dedicated POC requested (logs show sample traffic in drive/emberfield-poc-logs/metrics.csv). Goal: validate latency and cost at 3x demo load.
Legal/compliance: requested SOC2 Type II and pen-test summary; legal flagged retention controls and audit log retention period.
Quotes from product lead: "We need predictable tail latency during launches — unpredictability kills conversion."

Sales activity timeline:
- 2025-11-05: inbound signup, API key issued.
- 2026-01-12: demo with AE/SE (Priya/Dante) — walked through routing and rollouts.
- 2026-01-20: Hosted API trial started (30 days).
- 2026-02-18: Fireflies demo call (ff_2026-02-18-emberfield-demo).
- 2026-02-28: POC metrics review: identified cache hit rate opportunities (current prefix cache hit ~12%).
- 2026-03-01: Security questionnaire submitted; legal follow-up scheduled.

Requested deliverables from Redwood: dedicated capacity sizing recommendation (GPUs / pool configuration), QPS->GPU mapping under their observed token mix, pricing estimate for committed capacity vs burst, recommended batching and cache config to meet cost target.

Preliminary internal sizing idea: based on trial profile SE suggests starting Dedicated pool equivalent to 6 x 80GB GPUs (or 12 x 40GB equiv) with autoscale to 10 GPUs for sustained high-traffic windows; need Redwood validation with real performance numbers.
